ready_means_complete.name: ready_means_complete
ready_means_complete.value: "article_drafts"."status" not in ('ready', 'published') or ("article_drafts"."category_id" is not null and "article_drafts"."hero_media_id" is not null and "article_drafts"."text_finalized_at" is not null and "article_drafts"."title" <> '')

consents_one_subject.name: consents_one_subject
consents_one_subject.value:
("consents"."subject" = 'reader' and "consents"."reader_id" is not null)
       or ("consents"."subject" = 'subscriber' and "consents"."subscriber_id" is not null)
       or ("consents"."subject" = 'visitor' and "consents"."visitor_id" is not null)

homepage_slots_position_range.name: homepage_slots_position_range
homepage_slots_position_range.value: ("homepage_slots"."zone" = 'main' and "homepage_slots"."position" between 1 and 7) or ("homepage_slots"."zone" = 'trending' and "homepage_slots"."position" between 1 and 14)

sessions_one_subject.name: sessions_one_subject
sessions_one_subject.value:
("sessions"."kind" = 'staff' and "sessions"."user_id" is not null and "sessions"."reader_id" is null)
       or ("sessions"."kind" = 'reader' and "sessions"."reader_id" is not null and "sessions"."user_id" is null)

active_source_is_configured.name: active_source_is_configured
active_source_is_configured.value: "sources"."status" <> 'active' or ("sources"."method" is not null and "sources"."selector_config" is not null and "sources"."approved_at" is not null)
